description: This file defines an abstract class for non-cryptographic hash algorithms within the Orleans code generator project. It includes methods for appending data, computing hashes, and resetting state, serving as a base class for specific hash algorithm implementations.

classes.name: NonCryptographicHashAlgorithm
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a non-cryptographic hash algorithm with methods for data appending, hash retrieval, and state management.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a byte array to the current hash computation.

methods.name: Append(Stream)
methods.description: Reads data from a stream and appends it to the current hash computation.

methods.name: AppendAsyncCore
methods.description: Asynchronously reads from a stream and appends data to the hash, used internally.

methods.name: GetCurrentHash
methods.description: Returns the current hash value without modifying the internal state.

methods.name: TryGetCurrentHash
methods.description: Attempts to write the current hash to a span without modifying state, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: GetCurrentHash
methods.description: Writes the current hash to a span, throwing if the span is too short.

methods.name: GetHashAndReset
methods.description: Returns the current hash and resets the internal state.

methods.name: TryGetHashAndReset
methods.description: Attempts to write the hash and reset state, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: GetHashAndReset
methods.description: Writes the hash to a span and resets state, throwing if span is too short.

methods.name: GetHashAndResetCore
methods.description: Internal method that writes the current hash to a span and resets the state.
